{
  "paraphrased_article": [
    "The daughter of one of Europe’s longest-reigning monarchs, known for her claimed psychic abilities, recently wed a self-proclaimed sixth-generation shaman from California. The marriage of Norway’s Princess Märtha Louise to Durek Verrett on Saturday drew crowds to the misty streets of Geiranger, despite its unconventional nature.",
    "As the only child of King Harald and Queen Sonja, 52-year-old Märtha Louise holds the fourth position in Norway’s line of succession. She exchanged vows with 49-year-old Verrett in a traditional Norwegian church ceremony, held at the upscale Hotel Union in a quaint village near the stunning Geiranger fjord.",
    "The bride was accompanied by seven bridesmaids, including her teenage daughters, Leah and Emma Behn, from her previous marriage to the late Norwegian writer Ari Behn, whom she divorced in 2017. The guest list of 350 included notable figures such as Märtha Louise’s brother, Crown Prince Haakon, and his wife, Crown Princess Mette-Marit, as well as Sweden’s Crown Princess Victoria and Prince Daniel, and Prince Constantijn and Princess Laurentien of the Netherlands.",
    "Princess Märtha Louise has long lived outside the typical royal mold, having once identified as a clairvoyant and spent years operating a spiritual school where she taught students to connect with angels. In 2022, she announced her decision to step back from official royal responsibilities to concentrate on her and Verrett’s business ventures, aiming to create a clearer separation between their work and the Norwegian monarchy.",
    "Verrett, who refers to himself on social media as a 'servant of God' and an 'energy activator,' counts high-profile clients among his followers, including Gwyneth Paltrow, whom he has described as a 'soul sister.'"
  ]
}
```
